slides.headlineRest: Supply Chain Compromise Linked to China-Backed Storm-0940
slides.body: Microsoft has disclosed that the China state-aligned actor Storm-0940 was responsible for a recent supply chain compromise of the ConnectWise Cloud Backup application. During the incident, Storm-0940 utilized ARTEX, a Go-based agentic AI penetration testing framework. This framework, previously made closed-source due to its misuse, was employed to accelerate scanning operations during the attack. The sophisticated use of AI agents by a state-sponsored group underscores the evolving landscape of cyber threats.
